README: Models referenced by the export but not captured by it (their fields never appeared in a view), plus the infrastructure models the ORM needs (sequences, tracking, filters, cron, mail queue). Same field format as odoo_spec.json: s=label, ar=Arabic label, t=type, rel=relation, sel=selection, req/ro flags. Definitions follow Odoo 19 Enterprise.

sent=Quotation Sent ⇔ تم إرسال عرض السعر

field_sql.README: SQL for fields the export declares but computes in Python. The capture always wins over `models` above, so a computed field the screens need is given its expression here. {alias} is the row, {uid} the user, {model} the model name.

fleet.vehicle.contract_renewal_overdue: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fleet_vehicle_log_contract c WHERE c.vehicle_id = {alias}."id" AND c.state IN ('open', 'expired') AND c.expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND c.expiration_date < current_date AND coalesce(c.active, true))
fleet.vehicle.contract_renewal_due_soon: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fleet_vehicle_log_contract c WHERE c.vehicle_id = {alias}."id" AND c.state IN ('open', 'expired') AND c.expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND c.expiration_date >= current_date AND c.expiration_date <= current_date + 15 AND coalesce(c.active, true))
fleet.vehicle.service_activity: SELECT CASE WHEN min(s.date_from) FILTER (WHERE s.state <> 'done') < current_date THEN 'overdue' WHEN min(s.date_from) FILTER (WHERE s.state <> 'done') = current_date THEN 'today' WHEN min(s.date_from) FILTER (WHERE s.state <> 'done') IS NOT NULL THEN 'planned' ELSE 'none' END FROM fleet_vehicle_log_services s WHERE s.vehicle_id = {alias}."id" AND coalesce(s.active, true)
fleet.vehicle.bill_count: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.move_id) FROM account_move_line l WHERE l.vehicle_id = {alias}.id
fleet.vehicle.history_count: SELECT count(*) FROM fleet_vehicle_assignation_log g WHERE g.vehicle_id = {alias}.id

fleet.vehicle.log.contract.has_open_contract: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fleet_vehicle_log_contract o WHERE o.vehicle_id = {alias}."vehicle_id" AND o.state = 'open' AND coalesce(o.active, true))

account.move.alerts: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(x.code, jsonb_build_object('level', x.level)), '{}'::jsonb) FROM (  SELECT 'no_lines' AS code, 'warning' AS level   WHERE {alias}.state = 'draft'     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_move_line l WHERE l.move_id = {alias}."id" AND coalesce(l.display_type, 'product') NOT IN ('tax', 'payment_term'))  UNION ALL SELECT 'no_partner', 'warning'   WHERE {alias}.move_type <> 'entry' AND {alias}.partner_id IS NULL  UNION ALL SELECT 'no_invoice_date', 'warning'   WHERE {alias}.state = 'draft' AND {alias}.invoice_date IS NULL AND {alias}.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund', 'in_receipt')  UNION ALL SELECT 'unbalanced', 'danger'   WHERE {alias}.state = 'draft' AND {alias}.move_type = 'entry'     AND coalesce((SELECT round(sum(coalesce(l.debit, 0) - coalesce(l.credit, 0))::numeric, 2) FROM account_move_line l WHERE l.move_id = {alias}."id"), 0) <> 0  UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicated_ref', 'warning'   WHERE coalesce({alias}.ref, '') <> ''     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_move m2 WHERE m2."id" <> {alias}."id" AND m2.ref = {alias}.ref                   AND m2.move_type = {alias}.move_type AND m2.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM {alias}.partner_id)) x
account.move.status_in_payment: CASE WHEN {alias}.state IN ('draft', 'cancel') THEN {alias}.state WHEN coalesce({alias}.payment_state, 'not_paid') = 'not_paid' THEN CASE WHEN coalesce({alias}.is_move_sent, false) THEN 'sent' ELSE 'posted' END ELSE {alias}.payment_state END
account.move.highlight_send_button: {alias}.state = 'posted' AND {alias}.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'out_receipt') AND NOT coalesce({alias}.is_move_sent, false)
account.move.move_sent_values: CASE WHEN coalesce({alias}.is_move_sent, false) THEN 'sent' ELSE 'not_sent' END
account.move.invoice_has_outstanding: {alias}.state = 'posted' AND coalesce({alias}.amount_residual, 0) > 0 AND {alias}.move_type <> 'entry' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_payment p WHERE p.partner_id = {alias}.partner_id AND p.state IN ('paid', 'in_process') AND p.payment_type = CASE WHEN {alias}.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_receipt', 'in_refund') THEN 'inbound' ELSE 'outbound' END AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_payment_reconciled_invoice_ids_rel r WHERE r.account_payment_id = p.id))
account.move.company_currency_id: SELECT c.currency_id FROM res_company c WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id
account.move.country_code: SELECT co.code FROM res_company c JOIN res_country co ON co.id = c.country_id WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id
account.move.invoice_partner_display_name: SELECT p.name FROM res_partner p WHERE p.id = {alias}.partner_id
account.move.restrict_mode_hash_table: SELECT coalesce(j.restrict_mode_hash_table, false) FROM account_journal j WHERE j.id = {alias}.journal_id
account.move.is_exact_move_duplicate: coalesce({alias}.ref, '') <> '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_move m2 WHERE m2.id <> {alias}.id AND m2.ref = {alias}.ref AND m2.move_type = {alias}.move_type AND m2.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM {alias}.partner_id AND coalesce(m2.amount_total, 0) = coalesce({alias}.amount_total, 0) AND m2.state <> 'cancel')
account.move.invoice_payments_widget: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('title', 'Less Payment', 'outstanding', false, 'content', jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'date', p.date, 'amount', p.amount, 'currency_id', p.currency_id) ORDER BY p.date, p.id)) END FROM account_payment p JOIN account_payment_reconciled_invoice_ids_rel r ON r.account_payment_id = p.id WHERE r.account_move_id = {alias}.id AND p.state IN ('paid', 'in_process', 'reconciled')
account.move.invoice_outstanding_credits_debits_widge: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('title', 'Outstanding credits', 'outstanding', true, 'content', jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'date', p.date, 'amount', p.amount, 'currency_id', p.currency_id) ORDER BY p.date, p.id)) END FROM account_payment p WHERE {alias}.state = 'posted' AND coalesce({alias}.amount_residual, 0) > 0 AND {alias}.move_type <> 'entry' AND p.partner_id = {alias}.partner_id AND p.state IN ('paid', 'in_process') AND p.payment_type = CASE WHEN {alias}.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_receipt', 'in_refund') THEN 'inbound' ELSE 'outbound' END AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_payment_reconciled_invoice_ids_rel r WHERE r.account_payment_id = p.id)
account.move.count_asset: SELECT count(DISTINCT r.account_asset_id) FROM account_asset_original_move_line_ids_rel r JOIN account_move_line l ON l.id = r.account_move_line_id WHERE l.move_id = {alias}.id
account.move.reversal_move_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_move r WHERE r.reversed_entry_id = {alias}.id
account.move.payment_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_payment_reconciled_invoice_ids_rel r WHERE r.account_move_id = {alias}.id
account.move.sale_order_count: SELECT count(DISTINCT sl.order_id) FROM sale_order_line_invoice_lines_rel r JOIN sale_order_line sl ON sl.id = r.sale_order_line_id JOIN account_move_line l ON l.id = r.account_move_line_id WHERE l.move_id = {alias}.id
account.move.purchase_order_count: SELECT count(DISTINCT pl.order_id) FROM account_move_line l JOIN purchase_order_line pl ON pl.id = l.purchase_line_id WHERE l.move_id = {alias}.id
account.move.service_count: SELECT count(*) FROM fleet_vehicle_log_services s JOIN account_move_line l ON l.id = s.account_move_line_id WHERE l.move_id = {alias}.id

account.payment.amount_signed: CASE WHEN {alias}.payment_type = 'outbound' THEN -coalesce({alias}.amount, 0) ELSE coalesce({alias}.amount, 0) END
account.payment.amount_company_currency_signed: CASE WHEN {alias}.payment_type = 'outbound' THEN -coalesce({alias}.amount, 0) ELSE coalesce({alias}.amount, 0) END
account.payment.company_currency_id: SELECT c.currency_id FROM res_company c WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id
account.payment.country_code: SELECT co.code FROM res_company c JOIN res_country co ON co.id = c.country_id WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id
account.payment.payment_method_code: SELECT pm.code FROM account_payment_method_line l JOIN account_payment_method pm ON pm.id = l.payment_method_id WHERE l.id = {alias}.payment_method_line_id
account.payment.reconciled_invoices_type: CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_payment_reconciled_invoice_ids_rel r JOIN account_move m ON m.id = r.account_move_id WHERE r.account_payment_id = {alias}.id AND m.move_type IN ('out_refund', 'in_refund')) THEN 'credit_note' ELSE 'invoice' END
account.payment.reconciled_invoices_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_payment_reconciled_invoice_ids_rel r JOIN account_move m ON m.id = r.account_move_id WHERE r.account_payment_id = {alias}.id AND m.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'out_receipt')
account.payment.reconciled_bills_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_payment_reconciled_invoice_ids_rel r JOIN account_move m ON m.id = r.account_move_id WHERE r.account_payment_id = {alias}.id AND m.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund', 'in_receipt')

account.move.line.move_name: SELECT m.name FROM account_move m WHERE m.id = {alias}.move_id
account.move.line.company_currency_id: SELECT c.currency_id FROM res_company c WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id
account.move.line.is_same_currency: {alias}.currency_id IS NULL OR {alias}.currency_id = (SELECT c.currency_id FROM res_company c WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id)
account.move.line.account_internal_group: SELECT a.internal_group FROM account_account a WHERE a.id = {alias}.account_id
account.move.line.is_account_reconcile: SELECT coalesce(a.reconcile, false) FROM account_account a WHERE a.id = {alias}.account_id

res.partner.total_due: SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN m.move_type = 'out_refund' THEN -m.amount_residual ELSE m.amount_residual END), 0) FROM account_move m WHERE m.state = 'posted' AND m.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'out_receipt') AND coalesce(m.amount_residual, 0) <> 0 AND m.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.total_all_due: SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN m.move_type = 'out_refund' THEN -m.amount_residual ELSE m.amount_residual END), 0) FROM account_move m WHERE m.state = 'posted' AND m.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'out_receipt') AND coalesce(m.amount_residual, 0) <> 0 AND m.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.total_overdue: SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN m.move_type = 'out_refund' THEN -m.amount_residual ELSE m.amount_residual END), 0) FROM account_move m WHERE m.state = 'posted' AND m.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'out_receipt') AND coalesce(m.amount_residual, 0) <> 0 AND m.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id) AND coalesce(m.invoice_date_due, m.date) < current_date
res.partner.has_moves: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_move m WHERE m.partner_id = {alias}.id AND m.state = 'posted')
res.partner.sale_order_count: SELECT count(*) FROM sale_order o WHERE o.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.total_invoiced: SELECT coalesce(sum(m.amount_untaxed_signed), 0) FROM account_move m WHERE m.state = 'posted' AND m.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund') AND m.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.supplier_invoice_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_move m WHERE m.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund') AND m.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.purchase_order_count: SELECT count(*) FROM purchase_order o WHERE o.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.meeting_count: SELECT count(*) FROM calendar_event_partner_ids_rel r WHERE r.res_partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.task_count: SELECT count(*) FROM project_task t WHERE t.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id) AND coalesce(t.active, true)
res.partner.ticket_count: SELECT count(*) FROM helpdesk_ticket t WHERE t.partner_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM res_partner c WHERE c.id = {alias}.id OR c.commercial_partner_id = {alias}.id)
res.partner.payment_token_count: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_token t WHERE t.partner_id = {alias}.id
res.partner.employees_count: SELECT count(*) FROM hr_employee e WHERE e.work_contact_id = {alias}.id
res.partner.signature_count: SELECT count(*) FROM sign_request_item i WHERE i.partner_id = {alias}.id
res.partner.document_count: SELECT count(*) FROM documents_document d WHERE d.partner_id = {alias}.id
res.partner.partner_cars_count: SELECT count(*) FROM fleet_vehicle v WHERE v.driver_id = {alias}.id

account.account.internal_group: CASE WHEN {alias}.account_type = 'off_balance' THEN 'off' WHEN {alias}.account_type LIKE 'asset%' THEN 'asset' WHEN {alias}.account_type LIKE 'liability%' THEN 'liability' WHEN {alias}.account_type LIKE 'equity%' THEN 'equity' WHEN {alias}.account_type LIKE 'income%' THEN 'income' WHEN {alias}.account_type LIKE 'expense%' THEN 'expense' END
account.account.opening_debit: SELECT coalesce(sum(l.debit), 0) FROM account_move_line l JOIN account_move m ON m.id = l.move_id WHERE l.account_id = {alias}.id AND m.move_type = 'entry' AND m.ref = 'Opening Journal Entry' AND m.state <> 'cancel'
account.account.opening_credit: SELECT coalesce(sum(l.credit), 0) FROM account_move_line l JOIN account_move m ON m.id = l.move_id WHERE l.account_id = {alias}.id AND m.move_type = 'entry' AND m.ref = 'Opening Journal Entry' AND m.state <> 'cancel'
account.account.opening_balance: SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce(l.debit, 0) - coalesce(l.credit, 0)), 0) FROM account_move_line l JOIN account_move m ON m.id = l.move_id WHERE l.account_id = {alias}.id AND m.move_type = 'entry' AND m.ref = 'Opening Journal Entry' AND m.state <> 'cancel'
account.account.current_balance: SELECT coalesce(sum(l.balance), 0) FROM account_move_line l JOIN account_move m ON m.id = l.move_id WHERE l.account_id = {alias}.id AND m.state = 'posted'

account.journal.has_entries: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_move m WHERE m.journal_id = {alias}.id)
account.journal.has_posted_entries: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_move m WHERE m.journal_id = {alias}.id AND m.state = 'posted')
account.journal.default_account_type: SELECT a.account_type FROM account_account a WHERE a.id = {alias}.default_account_id
account.journal.country_code: SELECT co.code FROM res_company c JOIN res_country co ON co.id = c.country_id WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id
account.journal.company_partner_id: SELECT c.partner_id FROM res_company c WHERE c.id = {alias}.company_id
account.journal.default_account_active: SELECT coalesce(a.active, true) FROM account_account a WHERE a.id = {alias}.default_account_id

gamification.badge.granted_count: SELECT count(*) FROM gamification_badge_user b WHERE b.badge_id = {alias}.id

gamification.challenge.user_count: SELECT count(DISTINCT g.user_id) FROM gamification_goal g WHERE g.challenge_id = {alias}.id

hr.department.total_employee: SELECT count(*) FROM hr_employee e WHERE e.department_id = {alias}.id AND coalesce(e.active, true)
hr.department.plans_count: SELECT count(*) FROM mail_activity_plan p WHERE p.department_id = {alias}.id

hr.employee.hours_last_month: SELECT coalesce(sum(a.worked_hours), 0) FROM hr_attendance a WHERE a.employee_id = {alias}.id AND a.check_in >= date_trunc('month', now())
hr.employee.employee_cars_count: SELECT count(*) FROM fleet_vehicle v WHERE v.driver_employee_id = {alias}.id

product.attribute.number_related_products: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.product_template_id) FROM product_template_attribute_line l WHERE l.attribute_id = {alias}.id

project.task.subtask_count: SELECT count(*) FROM project_task c WHERE c.parent_id = {alias}.id AND coalesce(c.active, true)

survey.survey.answer_count: SELECT count(*) FROM survey_user_input u WHERE u.survey_id = {alias}.id AND NOT coalesce(u.test_entry, false)
survey.survey.answer_done_count: SELECT count(*) FROM survey_user_input u WHERE u.survey_id = {alias}.id AND NOT coalesce(u.test_entry, false) AND u.state = 'done'
survey.survey.success_count: SELECT count(*) FROM survey_user_input u WHERE u.survey_id = {alias}.id AND NOT coalesce(u.test_entry, false) AND coalesce(u.scoring_success, false)

survey.user_input.attempts_count: SELECT count(*) FROM survey_user_input u WHERE u.survey_id = {alias}.survey_id AND u.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM {alias}.partner_id AND NOT coalesce(u.test_entry, false)

account.asset.depreciation_entries_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_move m WHERE m.asset_id = {alias}.id AND m.state = 'posted'
account.asset.gross_increase_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_asset c WHERE c.parent_id = {alias}.id

account.depreciation.model.asset_count: SELECT count(*) FROM account_asset a WHERE a.model_id = {alias}.id

res.users.employee_count: SELECT count(*) FROM hr_employee e WHERE e.user_id = {alias}.id

purchase.order.invoice_count: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.move_id) FROM account_move_line l JOIN purchase_order_line pl ON pl.id = l.purchase_line_id WHERE pl.order_id = {alias}.id

product.template.sales_count: SELECT coalesce(sum(l.product_uom_qty), 0) FROM sale_order_line l JOIN sale_order o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN product_product p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE p.product_tmpl_id = {alias}.id AND o.state = 'sale' AND o.date_order >= now() - interval '365 days'
product.template.purchased_product_qty: SELECT coalesce(sum(l.product_qty), 0) FROM purchase_order_line l JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN product_product p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE p.product_tmpl_id = {alias}.id AND o.state IN ('purchase', 'done') AND o.date_order >= now() - interval '365 days'

product.category.product_count: SELECT count(*) FROM product_template t WHERE t.categ_id = {alias}.id

project.project.task_count: SELECT count(*) FROM project_task t WHERE t.project_id = {alias}.id AND coalesce(t.active, true)

helpdesk.stage.ticket_count: SELECT count(*) FROM helpdesk_ticket t WHERE t.stage_id = {alias}.id

helpdesk.ticket.partner_ticket_count: SELECT count(*) FROM helpdesk_ticket t WHERE t.partner_id = {alias}.partner_id AND t.id <> {alias}.id

appointment.type.meeting_count: SELECT count(*) FROM calendar_event e WHERE e.appointment_type_id = {alias}.id

approval.request.attachment_number: SELECT count(*) FROM ir_attachment a WHERE a.res_model = 'approval.request' AND a.res_id = {alias}.id

payment.provider.token_count: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_token t WHERE t.provider_id = {alias}.id

payment.transaction.refunds_count: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_transaction r WHERE r.source_transaction_id = {alias}.id

mail.canned.response.is_editable: {alias}.create_uid = {uid} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM res_users_group_ids_rel r JOIN res_groups g ON g.id = r.res_groups_id WHERE r.res_users_id = {uid} AND g.name = 'Role / Administrator')
mail.canned.response.is_shared: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mail_canned_response_group_ids_rel r WHERE r.mail_canned_response_id = {alias}.id)

fleet.vehicle.odometer.unit: SELECT v.odometer_unit FROM fleet_vehicle v WHERE v.id = {alias}.vehicle_id

hr.departure.reason.country_code: SELECT co.code FROM res_users u JOIN res_company c ON c.id = u.company_id JOIN res_country co ON co.id = c.country_id WHERE u.id = {uid}

fill_defaults.README: Odoo defaults for fields this build left empty on records it already holds. The loader makes them the field default, and schema sync fills existing rows where the field is still empty — what Odoo does when a module adds a field with a default.

sync_sql.README: Idempotent statements schema sync runs after the default fills, for data that behaviour added later would have written.
statements: UPDATE res_partner p SET customer_rank = r.n FROM (SELECT coalesce(c.commercial_partner_id, c.id) AS id, count(*)::int AS n FROM account_move m JOIN res_partner c ON c.id = m.partner_id WHERE m.state = 'posted' AND m.move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'out_receipt') GROUP BY 1) r WHERE p.id = r.id AND coalesce(p.customer_rank, 0) < r.n

UPDATE res_partner p SET supplier_rank = r.n FROM (SELECT coalesce(c.commercial_partner_id, c.id) AS id, count(*)::int AS n FROM account_move m JOIN res_partner c ON c.id = m.partner_id WHERE m.state = 'posted' AND m.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund', 'in_receipt') GROUP BY 1) r WHERE p.id = r.id AND coalesce(p.supplier_rank, 0) < r.n

inverse_fields.README: field_sql fields Odoo computes with an inverse: read from SQL, still editable; a model hook writes what they mean (an opening balance becomes a line of the opening entry).

stat_buttons.README: Smart buttons whose content the export dropped (Odoo puts a statinfo field or an o_stat_text span inside the button). Key "model|button name" -> [label en, label ar, counter field, widget]. The loader gives the button its label and, when the model has the field, shows the counter above it as Odoo does.
